text.description: Perform gymnastic and expressive exercises on the back of a moving horse led by a handler on the ground.

text.label: Grass skiing
text.description: Descend a grassy slope on special roller-equipped grass skis, steering and turning as you go.

text.label: Speed skiing
text.description: Ski down a speed course aiming to reach and record the highest speed. Results are evaluated by the measured downhill speed.

text.label: Telemark
text.description: Ski with free heels and make linked telemark turns: the rear ski follows the front, with the heel of the trailing foot raised.

text.label: Flight archery
text.description: Shoot arrows with a suitable bow to achieve maximum flight distance under flight-archery rules, rather than to hit a target.

text.label: Beach soccer
text.description: Play association football on sand, mainly moving and passing the ball with your feet, under beach-soccer rules.

text.label: Ski aerials
text.description: On skis, jump from a ramp, perform aerial acrobatic elements, and land on the slope.

text.label: Ski big air
text.description: Build speed on skis, perform one large jump or trick, and land in the landing area.

text.label: Ski halfpipe
text.description: Perform aerial elements on skis while riding the walls of a snow halfpipe. This is not snowboard halfpipe.

text.label: Moguls
text.description: Ski down a bumpy course with jumps and turns. Moguls and dual moguls are selectable competition formats.

text.label: Ski cross
text.description: Race on skis along a course with turns and terrain features at the same time as other competitors.

text.label: Ski slopestyle
text.description: Ski down a course with jumps and obstacles while performing judged elements.

text.label: High diving
text.description: Perform acrobatic dives into water from a high platform or a suitable natural elevation. Competition heights are set by the rules for each event and category, not by one universal threshold.

text.label: Hockey5s
text.description: Play a short 5-a-side hockey format on a small pitch with boards or rebound walls, under Hockey5s rules.

text.label: Indoor hockey
text.description: Play hockey with a ball in a hall on a small field with sideboards, under Indoor Hockey rules.

text.label: Inline freestyle
text.description: Perform technical maneuvers and combinations on inline skates, such as slalom, jumps, or slides. Elements depend on the chosen discipline.

text.label: Inline hockey
text.description: Play team hockey with a puck on roller skates in a marked or enclosed rink, under inline-hockey rules.

text.label: Inline speed skating
text.description: Race on inline skates over a distance on a track or road for time or placement.

text.label: IRB rescue race
aliases: Pilot an IRB in a lifesaving race
text.description: Pilot a motorized inflatable rescue boat (IRB) around a competition course in the surf zone. This is motorboat piloting, not rowing.

text.label: Judo kata
text.description: Perform a predetermined sequence of judo techniques and movements in a coordinated form with a partner.

text.label: Laser shooting
aliases: Shoot a laser pistol at a target
text.description: Aim and fire a sport laser pistol at a target in a specific discipline. Rifle shooting and firearm shooting are different activities.

text.label: Rescue line throw
aliases: Throw a rescue line in a pool event
text.description: Throw a rescue line toward a target or partner in a competitive pool event under ILS rules.

text.label: Manikin tow
aliases: Swim while carrying or towing a rescue mannequin
text.description: Swim in a pool while carrying or towing a rescue mannequin under the rules of the specific lifesaving event.

text.label: Obstacle swimming
text.description: Swim a pool race with prescribed obstacles under lifesaving-sport rules.

text.label: Rescue board race
aliases: Race on a lifesaving rescue board
text.description: Paddle or swim on a rescue board over a surf course in the corresponding lifesaving race.

text.label: Pool lifesaving combined
aliases: Complete a combined pool lifesaving event
text.description: Complete a sequence of swimming and rescue stages in a pool, including the mannequin approach required by the event rules.

text.label: Rescue ski race
aliases: Race on a lifesaving rescue ski
text.description: Paddle or steer a rescue ski over a water course in the corresponding lifesaving race.

text.label: Surf rescue race
text.description: Swim through the surf and along a set water-course line in a competitive lifesaving discipline.

text.label: Microlight
text.description: Pilot a light powered aircraft in the microlight or ultralight class; its class and flight format follow the applicable rules.

text.label: Flying a model aircraft
aliases: Pilot a model aircraft in flight
text.description: Pilot a model aircraft in flight, completing flight tasks under the rules of the chosen class. Building the model is a separate activity.

text.label: Surfski
aliases: Race a surfski in open water
text.description: Paddle a long, open, sit-on-top surfski kayak along a coastal or ocean route. Some races may use a downwind format.

text.label: Pankration
text.description: Compete in a martial art combining permitted striking and wrestling actions under pankration rules.

text.label: Paramotor
text.description: Pilot a paraglider wing with an engine under the rules for its class. This is not fixed-wing microlight flying.

text.label: Rhythmic gymnastics
text.description: Perform a gymnastics routine with an apparatus, combining choreographed sequences with apparatus work in an individual or group exercise.

text.label: Rink hockey
text.description: Play team hockey with a ball, roller skates, and sticks under rink-hockey rules.

text.label: Downhill skating
aliases: Descend a downhill course on roller skates
text.description: Descend a prepared downhill course on roller skates, controlling speed and trajectory.

text.label: Roller downhill and slalom
aliases: Take part in roller downhill or slalom
text.description: A World Skate named family covering Downhill and Slalom. Timing the family as a whole is valid; a downhill speed run and negotiating slalom markers are separate optional actions.

text.label: Roller freestyle
text.description: Perform trick lines or elements on roller skates in a park, on street features, or in a vert ramp.

text.label: Roller slalom
text.description: Maneuver on roller skates between marked gates or markers in a slalom format.

text.label: Running
text.description: Run with a running stride as physical or sport practice. Route, surface, distance, pace, training, and competition format can be specified separately.

text.label: RC sailboats
text.description: From shore, use a radio transmitter to change a small sailboat model’s course and sails as it competes in a fleet race.

text.label: Wing foiling
text.description: Stand on a board with an underwater foil, hold and steer a hand wing, and use the wind to move above the water. Competition disciplines may be specified by a separate format.

text.label: Freestyle scooter
text.description: Perform tricks and lines on a scooter in a skatepark or street setting under a freestyle competition format.

text.label: Short track
text.description: Race with other skaters around a short oval ice track, completing the distance for speed.

text.label: Snow volleyball
text.description: Play volleyball on a prepared snow court, sending the ball over a net. Snow and the stability of footwear affect movement and tactics.

text.label: Parallel snowboard slalom
aliases: Race in parallel snowboard giant slalom
text.description: Ride a snowboard through gates on a marked speed course in a parallel head-to-head race.

text.label: Snowboard cross
text.description: Race a snowboard course with several competitors, negotiating turns and rollers for speed.

text.label: Freestyle snowboarding
aliases: Practice freestyle snowboarding in park or pipe
text.description: Ride a snowboard in halfpipe, slopestyle, or big air, performing judged jumps and tricks. This is not an ordinary downhill run.

text.label: Squash 57
text.description: Play Squash 57, also called racketball: use a racket of the specified type to hit a larger, more resilient ball against the front wall under this game’s own rules.

text.label: Surf boat race
text.description: Row as a team in a rescue surf boat over a race course in the surf zone. This is a rowing discipline, not a motorized one.

text.label: Synchronized skating
text.description: As a group, perform a coordinated program of movements, formations, and figures on ice.

text.label: Poomsae
text.description: Perform set sequences of taekwondo techniques, stances, and movements in solo or synchronized demonstration practice.

text.label: Baseball5
text.description: Play Baseball5, a team game of hitting a soft ball by hand and running quickly on a compact field under Baseball5 rules.

text.label: Wakesurfing
text.description: Ride a board on a wave made by a motorboat, performing turns and other maneuvers. A tow rope may be used to start or get up again, but the rider releases it during a wakesurfing pass.

text.label: Wildwater racing
aliases: Race down whitewater in a kayak or canoe
text.description: Race down a rapid river in a kayak or canoe on a sprint or classic course.

text.label: Bobsleigh
text.description: Ride a steerable bobsleigh down a prepared ice track, building speed at the start and steering through the turns. The chosen format may be solo (monobob) or team.

text.label: Freestyle skiing
text.description: Ski in a selected freestyle discipline: moguls or dual moguls, aerials, ski cross, or park and pipe (halfpipe, slopestyle, big air). The discipline type should remain available for refinement. Select a named event subtype when useful; the parent may also be selected and timed as one complete freestyle-skiing session.

text.label: Luge
text.description: Lie on your back on a small racing sled and descend an artificial ice track feet first, steering with your body and legs.

text.label: Skeleton
text.description: Sprint to start, lie face-down and head-first on a skeleton sled, and descend an ice track steering with your body and sled.

text.label: Ski jumping
text.description: Build speed on special skis on a jump, take off, fly, and land; the jump is judged for distance and technique.

text.label: Article or text
text.description: Read an article, essay, publication, or other individual text.

text.label: Book
text.description: Read all or part of a book in print or electronic form.

text.label: References and manuals
text.description: Consult a reference work, manual, or documentation for a needed explanation or fact.

text.label: Research paper
aliases: Write a research paper, abstract, or dissertation section
text.description: Write a research paper, abstract, or section of a dissertation.

text.label: Annotations and bibliography
aliases: Annotate or tag a source and keep bibliographic notes
text.description: Annotate or tag a source and maintain bibliographic notes.

text.label: Archive and cataloging
aliases: Digitize or catalog an archive or collection
text.description: Digitize, catalog, or describe an archive or collection.

text.label: Qualitative analysis
aliases: Code qualitative material and identify themes
text.description: Code qualitative material, look for themes, and compare cases.

text.label: Data and material collection
aliases: Collect or extract data, documents, or samples
Collect or extract documents and samples
text.description: Collect or extract data, documents, or samples.

text.label: Research ethics
aliases: Prepare research ethics, consent, and participant or data protections
text.description: Prepare the ethical rationale, consent materials, and protections for participants or data.

text.label: Experiment
aliases: Conduct an experiment or controlled test
Conduct a laboratory test or controlled trial
text.description: Conduct an experiment, laboratory test or sample, or controlled trial.

text.label: Sample collection
aliases: Collect field, biological, geological, or production samples
text.description: Select and collect samples in the field, including biological, geological, or production samples.

text.label: Question and hypothesis
aliases: Frame a research question, hypothesis, or problem
Define a hypothesis and research scope
text.description: Formulate the question, hypothesis, or problem and define the scope of the research.

text.label: Grant application
aliases: Write a grant or research-funding proposal
text.description: Write an application for a grant or research funding.

text.label: Research interview
aliases: Conduct an expert or life-history interview
text.description: Conduct a research interview, life-history interview, or expert interview.

text.label: Lab session prep
aliases: Prepare reagents, samples, equipment, and the lab
text.description: Prepare reagents, samples, instruments, and the environment for a research session.

text.label: Lab protocol
aliases: Carry out a laboratory procedure or protocol
text.description: Carry out a laboratory procedure or protocol, excluding engineering maintenance of equipment.

text.label: Literature review
text.description: Gather and synthesize a body of literature or previous research.

text.label: Measurements
aliases: Take measurements for research, inspection, or testing
Measure for a study or test
text.description: Take measurements for research, inspection, or a test.

text.label: Observation and field notes
aliases: Observe people, processes, or environments in the field
text.description: Observe a person, process, or environment and keep field notes.

text.label: Methodology
aliases: Choose a method and design a research protocol
text.description: Choose a method and design a procedure, protocol, or data-collection plan.

text.label: Publishing results
aliases: Prepare research for publication and deposit its data in a repository with limitations described
text.description: Prepare research for publication, deposit data or materials in a repository, and describe limitations.

text.label: Reproducing a result
aliases: Try to reproduce a published result
Reproduce a published experiment or result
text.description: Try to reproduce a published experiment, algorithm, or computational result.

text.label: Science communication
aliases: Explain research findings or communicate science
text.description: Explain findings to an audience, communicate science, or present science to the public.

text.label: Lab notebook
aliases: Keep a research log or document data provenance
Keep a lab notebook or methods diary
text.description: Keep a laboratory notebook or methods diary, or document the provenance of data.

text.label: Research report
aliases: Prepare a research report, white paper, or technical memo
text.description: Prepare a research report, white paper, or technical memorandum.

text.label: Peer review
aliases: Peer-review a paper, proposal, or research method
Review a paper, proposal, or research method
text.description: Peer-review an article, proposal, or research method.

text.label: Screening materials
aliases: Screen materials against inclusion or exclusion criteria
text.description: Select relevant materials by applying inclusion and exclusion criteria.

text.label: Finding sources
aliases: Search primary sources, literature, and regulatory, historical, or technical sources. For reading, use the seeded activity.reading.book/article/reference categories and axis.context/axis.discipline
text.description: Find primary, scholarly, regulatory, historical, technical, or other sources for a research question. Reading the materials found is a separate activity; record the subject and context on independent axes. For reading itself, use the seeded `activity.reading.book/article/reference` categories and specify `axis.context` or `axis.discipline`.

text.label: Surveys and questionnaires
aliases: Design a survey or collect questionnaire data
text.description: Design or conduct a survey, or collect questionnaire responses.

text.label: Synthesis and conclusions
aliases: Synthesize sources and observations into a conclusion
Combine sources or observations into an answer or explanation
text.description: Combine sources or observations into an answer, conclusion, or coherent explanation. This is broader than a literature review and can include, for example, synthesis of genealogical or archival evidence.

text.label: Access control
aliases: Verify access rights and manage entry
Verify access authorization and manage entry
text.description: Verify authorization to access a place or resource and manage entry or passes.

text.label: Post-incident review
aliases: Review lessons and corrective actions after a drill or incident
text.description: Review lessons learned and corrective actions after a drill or incident.

text.label: Risk assessment
text.description: Assess hazards and the potential consequences of an activity or site.

text.label: Safety compliance check
aliases: Audit a program or site for required compliance
Audit a program or site against requirements
text.description: Check a program or site for compliance with mandatory requirements.

text.label: First aid and rescue
aliases: Provide first aid or take part in a rescue
Provide first aid or participate in rescue
text.description: Record providing first aid or participating in a rescue as an activity category only, not as instructions.

text.label: Inspecting conditions and equipment
aliases: Inspect conditions or equipment and record findings
text.description: Inspect site conditions or equipment and document observations.

text.label: Incident investigation
aliases: Investigate an incident and document the facts
text.description: Establish the sequence of events, gather facts, and document them.

text.label: Alarm monitoring
aliases: Monitor an alarm or control system and escalate incidents
Monitor alerts and escalate an incident
text.description: Monitor an alarm or monitoring system and escalate an incident.

text.label: Patrolling
aliases: Patrol an area or site, or keep watch
text.description: Patrol an area or facility, or maintain a watch.

text.label: Evacuation planning
aliases: Plan evacuation communications and interagency coordination
text.description: Plan preparedness, evacuation communications, and coordination between organizations.

text.label: Incident evidence handling
text.description: Protect or account for incident materials or records within an established process.

text.label: Taking calls
aliases: Receive a call or signal and relay it to the responsible person
Receive and relay a call or signal
text.description: Receive a call or signal and pass it to the person responsible.

text.label: Report and shift handover
aliases: Prepare an incident report, shift handoff, or closeout
Prepare a report and shift handoff
text.description: Prepare a report, shift handoff, or final incident review.

text.label: Incident response
aliases: Respond to an incident and coordinate response services
text.description: Respond to an incident and coordinate responding services. This category does not prescribe tactics.

text.label: Security screening

text.label: Workshop and repairs
aliases: DIY and maker projects: making and repair
text.description: Make, assemble, modify, and repair things independently as a hobby or creative practice.

text.label: Music, sound and stage
text.description: Perform and create music and sound, rehearse, and prepare stage performances.

text.label: Writing and online expression
text.description: Create texts and posts for personal creative expression, including in online formats.

text.label: Live performances
aliases: Attending live performances as an audience member
text.description: Attend concerts, plays, and other live performances as a spectator or listener.

text.label: Museums and heritage
text.description: Visit museums, exhibitions, monuments, and other places where culture and heritage can be explored.

text.label: Spectator sports and fun
text.description: Attend sports events as a spectator or visit entertainment venues for leisure.

text.label: Board and card games
text.description: Games played with a board, cards, miniatures, or other physical game components.

text.label: Puzzles and solo games
aliases: Puzzles, solo games, and word games
text.description: Solve puzzles, play solo games, or engage in games involving words, numbers, or logical conditions.

text.label: Video games
text.description: Video games played on computers, consoles, phones, and other digital devices.

text.label: Flexibility and mindful movement
aliases: Flexibility, body control, and mindful movement
text.description: Movement, flexibility, breathing, and movement-control practices, including stretching, yoga, Pilates, gymnastics, and similar activities.

text.label: Cardio and aerobics
text.description: Endurance and aerobic training, including running, walking, swimming, aerobics, and cardio-machine workouts.

text.label: Rehabilitation
text.description: Exercises to restore movement, balance, and physical function, including a prescribed home rehabilitation program.

text.label: Strength and conditioning
text.description: Strength training and general physical conditioning using weights, machines, or body weight.

text.label: Wheels and gliding
text.description: Riding and sports on roller skates, skateboards, scooters, and other wheeled or sliding equipment, including adaptive disciplines.

text.label: Walking and running
text.description: Running, walking, hiking, and other activities involving travel on foot, including obstacle courses, orienteering, and mountain terrain.

text.label: Cycling
text.description: Cycling workouts, rides, and sports using standard, electric, hand, or other bicycles, as well as stationary bikes.

text.label: Climbing and mountaineering
text.description: Climb or ascend on rock, ice, mountain terrain, or an artificial wall.

text.label: Martial arts
text.description: Practice combat sports and martial arts through techniques, forms, sparring, and competition.

text.label: Team ball games
text.description: Team and sports games played with a ball, puck, disc, or other game object.

text.label: Equestrian and motorsport
text.description: Horse riding and equestrian disciplines, as well as competitive driving of cars, motorcycles, karts, and other motor vehicles.

text.label: Athletics and gymnastics
text.description: Track-and-field and gymnastics activities, including running, jumping, throwing, combined events, apparatus exercises, and acrobatics.

text.label: Racquet and net sports
text.description: Play with a racquet and a ball or shuttlecock on a court, table, or playing area, including net and wall games.

text.label: Multisport
text.description: Training and competition sessions that combine several types of movement or sports disciplines.

text.label: Precision and aim
aliases: Precision, aim, field, and individual-skill sports
text.description: Sports in which precision, orientation, or individual technique matters, from billiards and shooting to golf and equestrian disciplines.

text.label: Para and wheelchair sports
text.description: Sports disciplines and variants using adapted rules or equipment, or a sports wheelchair.

text.label: Adaptive practices
text.description: Physical activities whose conditions, equipment, or way of performing them are tailored to the participant’s accessibility needs.

text.label: Camping and nights outdoors
aliases: Camping and overnight stays as leisure
text.description: Camping and overnight stays outdoors as a leisure activity in their own right.

text.label: Walks and time outdoors
text.description: Walk or spend time outdoors for recreation, observation, and enjoyment.

text.label: Nature watching
text.description: Observe, study, and document nature and the surrounding place while there.

text.label: In the field
text.description: Observe and collect data on site: record species, weather, sounds, and environmental conditions.

text.label: At a computer
text.description: Process observations and research materials at a computer: identify objects, annotate data, verify records, or transcribe documents.

text.label: Outdoor recreation
text.description: Leisure activities in nature where relaxation and being in a natural environment are central.

text.label: Quiet rest
text.description: Rest or reflect quietly; distinguish this from sleep, religious practice, and media use.

text.label: Window shopping
aliases: Casual browsing of places and shop windows
text.description: Look around places or shop windows without a specific purchase in mind; this is an activity, not a place.

text.label: Feeds, sites and forums
aliases: Personal media browsing with no specific content stated
text.description: Browse feeds, websites, and collections, moving between different pieces of content.

text.label: Listening
text.description: Listen to music, spoken recordings, podcasts, and other audio content.

text.label: Leisure reading
text.description: Read books, articles, and other texts for oneself during free time.

text.label: Watching
text.description: Watch films, series, programs, videos, and streams.

text.label: Adaptive sports
text.description: Physical training with conditions, equipment, or movements adapted to the participant’s abilities.

text.label: Air and adventure
text.description: Air and adventure sports, with their specialized skills and equipment.

text.label: Dance
text.description: Dance activities and expressive movement practice, including learning, rehearsal, and performance.

text.label: Fitness
text.description: Physical exercise and training to develop strength, endurance, mobility, and overall fitness.

text.label: Movement on the go
aliases: Movement for physical activity or training
text.description: Walking, running, and other forms of locomotion chosen as physical activity or training.

text.label: Game sports
text.description: Game-based and competitive sports, including training and participation in competitions.

text.label: Water
text.description: Swimming, diving, and other physical activities in or under water.

text.label: Winter and ice
text.description: Physical activities and sports disciplines on snow or ice.

text.label: Citizen science
aliases: Citizen science, observation, and data contribution
text.description: Observe, collect, and submit data as part of research and nature projects open to participants.

text.label: Refereeing competitions
text.description: Apply competition rules during an event, track play and results, and make or signal decisions as a referee or official. This excludes coaching a participant, competing, producing the event, spectating, and general quality auditing. Sport and official role are facets.

text.label: Veterinary euthanasia
text.description: Perform euthanasia on an animal in a professional veterinary context. Distinguish this from assessing the animal’s condition, palliative care, and post-mortem examination.

text.label: Passing a law
aliases: Deliberate and enact a public law or regulation
text.description: Debate and vote in an established public legislative body to adopt, amend, or repeal a law or public regulation. Distinguish this from drafting a proposal, analyzing policy options, public consultation, and administrative enforcement. Role and jurisdiction remain facets.

text.label: Urban planning
aliases: Plan urban development and land use
text.description: Develop, compare, and present spatial plans for the use and development of urban or rural areas and sites, such as residential areas, parks, public spaces, roads, or commercial and industrial locations. This is planning and design, not physical construction or maintaining a land register.

text.label: Transport planning
aliases: Plan road and public transport systems
text.description: Develop and present plans for routes and the organization of road traffic or public transport to improve system-wide efficiency and safety. Distinguish this from dispatching a specific trip, managing traffic in real time, and choosing a personal route.

text.label: Speech therapy
text.description: Plan and deliver a professional therapy or rehabilitation session addressing speech, language, communication, or swallowing; observe progress and adapt the program. Distinguish this from teaching a foreign language or subject, a separate diagnostic assessment, general advice, and the client’s independent practice.

text.label: Career guidance
text.description: Hold an individual counseling session about choosing a course or program, study schedules, school adjustment, study habits, education and career options, and career direction; help identify a next education or career step. Distinguish this from teaching subject matter, recruiting, independently searching for a job, and clinical therapy.

text.label: Financial plan
aliases: Develop a personal or organizational financial plan
text.description: Set financial goals, analyze resources and risk preferences, and develop or revise a plan of actions and investments as needs or markets change. Distinguish this from recording transactions, preparing an accounting budget, recommending a particular product, and executing a transaction.

text.label: Test plan
aliases: Design a software testing plan and test cases
text.description: Set software testing goals and scope, define checks and test scenarios, identify needed environments and methods for recording and analyzing results, and document the plan, procedures, or test cases before tests are run. Distinguish this from actually running unit, integration, end-to-end, security, or performance tests, and from writing a general development specification.

text.label: Archival conservation
text.description: Assess condition and carry out or arrange measures to preserve physical or digital archival or collection material, prevent deterioration, and maintain its usability. Distinguish this from collecting, cataloging, digitizing, placing material in storage, archiving files, and repairing an arbitrary object. Material, object, and role are specified separately.

text.label: Source authentication
aliases: Authenticate a historical source and assess its provenance
text.description: Compare provenance, indicators of origin, date or authorship, and consistency of a historical document or artifact to assess whether it is authentic and usable as a source. Distinguish this from cataloging, simple searching, selecting by relevance, fact-checking claims in a text, and legal assessment of evidence. Source type, period, and method are facets.

text.label: Psychological testing
aliases: Administer and interpret a psychometric assessment
text.description: Select and administer a standardized measure of psychological characteristics, assess responses, and interpret results for feedback or decision-making. Distinguish this from biological sample analysis, an ordinary interview, a school test, and general data collection. Test type and purpose are specified separately.

text.label: Dispute mediation
aliases: Mediate a social or personal dispute
text.description: Neutrally structure communication between parties to a conflict or dispute and help them develop a resolution or agreement. This excludes advising one party, general negotiation of transaction terms, judicial decision-making, and facilitating an ordinary meeting. Topic, parties, and professional role are facets.

text.label: Conducting
text.description: Lead a joint vocal or instrumental performance by setting and coordinating entrances, tempo, and musical interpretation. This excludes composing or arranging, playing or singing individually, an ordinary rehearsal without conducting, and general leadership of a work meeting. Ensemble type, work, and live or recorded context are facets.

text.label: Choreography
text.description: Create and structure movements, steps, or gestures into a dance composition or sequence for a theme, music, stage, recording, personal project, or another purpose. This excludes performing an already-set dance, sports dance training, and an ordinary rehearsal. Style, music, project, and role are facets.

text.label: Directing a production
aliases: Direct a stage or media production
text.description: Guide the artistic interpretation of dramatic, musical, or documentary material; direct performers and coordinate staging decisions for the stage, radio, film, or television. This excludes production-only budgeting or scheduling, acting, editing, and carrying out set, lighting, or sound work. Media or production type and role are facets.

text.label: Polishing
text.description: Polish a product or material surface to improve its finish; retain the target surface or object as a facet.

text.label: Sharpening
text.description: Sharpen a tool or blade to restore or improve its cutting edge; tool type and context remain facets.

text.label: Catching stray animals
aliases: Impound a stray animal under public authority
text.description: Take a stray animal into authorized public custody as part of an animal-control case.

text.label: Promotions and dismissals
aliases: Participate in staff promotion or dismissal decisions
text.description: Participate as a retail supervisor in decisions to promote or dismiss staff.

text.label: Makeup for clients
text.description: Apply makeup to a client as a professional beauty service.

text.label: Bathhouse services
text.description: Attend to a client during a bathing service in a beauty or personal-care setting. Massage is a separate activity.

text.label: Hair removal
aliases: Remove unwanted hair by waxing, sugaring or depilation
text.description: Remove a client's unwanted hair using waxing, sugaring or other depilation methods.

text.label: Massage
text.description: Provide a client-facing facial or body massage as a beauty/personal-care service.

text.label: Pedicure and foot care
aliases: Provide personal care for foot ailments
text.description: Provide personal-care services for foot ailments within the practitioner's role; clinical diagnosis is a separate activity.

text.label: Manicure
text.description: Clean, shape or polish a client’s nails as a beauty/personal-care service.

text.label: Skin care
aliases: Clean skin and apply creams or lotions
text.description: Clean a client’s skin and apply creams or lotions as a professional beauty service.

text.label: Haircuts
text.description: Cut a client’s hair as a professional hairdressing service.

text.label: Shaving and beard trims
text.description: Shave or trim a client’s beard or moustache as a professional barbering service.

text.label: Braids, dreads and extensions
aliases: Style braids/dreadlocks or add hair extensions
text.description: Style a client’s hair into dreadlocks or braids, or add hair extensions as a professional hairdressing service.

text.label: Hair coloring
text.description: Apply hair tint/color as a professional hairdressing service.

text.label: Scalp care
text.description: Provide scalp care as a professional hairdressing service, distinct from clinical diagnosis or medical treatment.

text.label: Hair washing
text.description: Wash a client’s hair as a professional hairdressing service.

text.label: Perms
text.description: Wave a client’s hair as a professional hairdressing service.

text.label: Journal subscriptions
aliases: Administer institutional journal and periodical subscriptions
text.description: Maintain and renew an institution’s serial publication subscriptions; distinct from a reader purchasing a magazine or maintaining a subscriber account.

text.label: Administering a licensing exam
aliases: Administer and score an official licensing test
text.description: Deliver/operate an assessment required for license qualification and evaluate/score applicant responses; distinct from the applicant taking an exam, the licensing case workflow and generic output quality review.

text.label: Piloting
aliases: Pilot and navigate aircraft in flight
text.description: Operate, control and navigate an aircraft during flight under established procedures, including interactions/coordination needed for safe flight. Distinct from ground/passenger travel, flight briefing, aircraft maintenance and air-traffic control.

text.label: Organizing group travel
aliases: Arrange group travel, tours and accommodation for clients
text.description: Plan and book travel/tour and accommodation services for a group or client, including bulk reservations; distinct from the traveler’s own trip, internal work scheduling, and freight routing.

text.label: Checking returned goods
aliases: Inspect returned retail goods and decide the seller’s response
text.description: Inspect goods returned by a customer and decide the retailer’s appropriate disposition (e.g. refund, replacement or rejection); distinct from buyer return, support inquiry and general quality review.

text.label: Assessing hardware and software needs
aliases: Assess ICT equipment/software needs for upgrades
text.description: Identify computer/network areas where equipment or software should be upgraded, based on performance/requirements; distinct from configuring/implementing an upgrade or routine performance monitoring.

text.label: Interior requirements analysis
aliases: Research and assess interior spatial/functional/safety requirements
text.description: Research and evaluate spatial, functional, efficiency, safety and aesthetic requirements that constrain an interior design before formulating the design concept; distinct from client intake, concept creation and site installation.

text.label: Price fairness review
aliases: Assess regulated price/cost appropriateness for consumer protection
text.description: Compare regulated prices or costs of goods/services with applicable rules and evidence to determine consumer-protection appropriateness; distinct from market trend monitoring, ordinary financial analysis, tax assessment and generic compliance inspection.

text.label: Scouting a sports venue
aliases: Assess competitors and conditions at a sporting venue
text.description: Observe or assess other competitors and venue conditions relevant to a sporting event from a player’s perspective; distinct from official judging, site compliance inspection, spectator viewing and business market monitoring.

text.label: Helping library users
aliases: Help library users find and access basic library resources
text.description: Provide user-side assistance navigating a library collection/resources; distinct from guest support broadly and cataloging the collection itself.

text.label: Seizing prohibited goods
aliases: Seize prohibited or undeclared goods under authority
text.description: Take custody of goods determined to be prohibited/undeclared under customs or immigration law; distinct from inspection, receipt/storage of regular inventory or shipping goods.

text.label: Childbirth assistance
text.description: Provide professional care during childbirth/delivery, either as the responsible practitioner or as clinical support, distinct from pregnancy advice, assessment, routine nursing care and postpartum follow-up.

text.label: Matching buyers and sellers
aliases: Broker introductions and match buyers with sellers
text.description: Establish contact and connect prospective buyers and sellers of a commodity as an intermediary, without taking the buyer or seller’s inventory position; distinct from selling, purchasing and generic external communication.

text.label: Freight brokerage
aliases: Broker cargo space and storage capacity for clients
text.description: Source, buy/sell or negotiate access to cargo-space and related freight/storage capacity for client commodities as a broker; distinct from dispatching one’s own shipment or maintaining one’s own inventory.

text.label: Interest and fee calculation
aliases: Calculate interest, brokerage charges and stamp duties on a transaction
text.description: Calculate transaction-specific interest, commissions/charges and tax/stamp duty payable; distinct from business financial modeling, brokerage execution, general estimates and entering the resulting amount in accounts.

text.label: Ticket checking
aliases: Check validity of passenger travel tickets at boarding
text.description: Verify that a passenger’s existing transport ticket, pass or boarding credential is valid for the planned journey or boarding; distinct from selling/issuing the ticket, checking identity, generic venue access control and a passenger’s self-check.

text.label: Questioning a witness or suspect
aliases: Conduct an investigative interview with a witness or suspect
text.description: Elicit and verify case information from witnesses or suspects in an authorized investigation; distinct from recruitment, customer discovery, patient intake and legal-client intake.

text.label: Containing hazardous materials
aliases: Contain or limit spread of hazardous substances during an incident
text.description: Limit the spread of a dangerous substance as part of a fire/accident response; distinct from hazard assessment, routine waste management and general incident coordination.

text.label: Train routing
aliases: Coordinate train routings within a railway division or zone
text.description: Direct the routing of trains through the assigned rail network division/zone and retain the operational records; distinct from driving trains, passenger route planning and generic freight dispatch.

text.label: Plating and garnishing
aliases: Design plating and decorative food displays
text.description: Determine visual presentation and create decorative displays/plating for prepared food; distinct from cooking, interior/display-space design and decorating a retail merchandise window.

text.label: Lab cultures
text.description: Grow/cultivate biological cultures or organisms as a laboratory operation, distinct from preparing a sample/reagent, collecting the source specimen or testing/analyzing the culture.

text.label: Recipe development
text.description: Create or refine a recipe or culinary formula, distinct from deciding which dishes appear on a menu, preparing ingredients, or cooking a meal. Professional or household setting and intended diners are facets.

text.label: Animal control calls
aliases: Respond to animal-control complaints and take authorized custody of stray animals
text.description: Handle a public animal-control case by responding to animal complaints, issuing authorized warnings or citations, and impounding stray animals when authorized. Distinguish public-control work from owner-side pet care, animal husbandry and ordinary customer complaints.

text.label: Data entry
aliases: Enter data from source documents into a computer repository
text.description: Transcribe numbers/codes/text from source material into a database or electronic processing system; distinct from validating/correcting entered values, analyzing data and migrating data between systems.

text.label: Currency exchange
aliases: Exchange one currency for another at a service counter
text.description: Convert a customer’s cash from one currency into another as a requested counter service; distinct from analyzing FX markets, receiving a payment, paying an invoice or the customer’s own currency exchange.

text.label: Signing on a client’s behalf
aliases: Execute or sign an agreement for a represented party
text.description: Sign or execute a negotiated agreement on behalf of a principal under delegated authority; distinct from drafting/reviewing/negotiating the document or personally signing one’s own consumer contract.

text.label: Firefighting
aliases: Fight and extinguish fires as a professional responder
text.description: Respond to and extinguish fires as an emergency-service action.

text.label: Wig fitting
aliases: Fit wigs and hairpieces to customer requirements
text.description: Fit a wig or hairpiece to a client’s requirements; distinct from natural-hair styling and the customer wearing/adjusting their own wig.

text.label: Flight plan
aliases: Prepare and submit a flight plan
text.description: Create, complete and submit a professional aircraft flight-plan document for a flight, distinct from receiving a preflight briefing, approving another operator’s plan or navigating in flight.

text.label: Flight plan review
aliases: Review and approve a flight plan
text.description: Examine a flight plan and approve/clear it for operational use in the relevant aviation role, distinct from preparing/submitting the plan, general air-traffic control and a preflight briefing.

text.label: Work methods and efficiency
text.description: Collect or analyse operational data about work methods, sequence, resource use and productivity to improve efficiency/safety; distinct from general project resource planning or process documentation.

text.label: Insurance loss assessment
aliases: Assess insured loss, damage and policy liability
text.description: Assess the extent of insured loss/damage and the liability of an insurer/underwriter under policy coverage; distinct from generic cost estimation, claim-file administration, and the insured claimant’s personal claim handling.

text.label: Insurance risk assessment
aliases: Assess customer insurance needs and insurable risk
text.description: Elicit a customer’s circumstances and determine the type/degree of insurance coverage and risk required; distinct from customer-side insurance administration, explaining/quoting a product, or handling a claim.

text.label: Lab supply tracking
text.description: Observe and track how laboratory consumables are being used over time to control remaining quantity/quality and anticipate project needs. Keep separate from sample testing, receiving a delivery, retail stocktaking and project cost estimation.

text.label: Developing lab methods
aliases: Develop, standardize and validate laboratory methods
text.description: Create, standardize, evaluate or modify laboratory procedures, methods and tests, including checking result accuracy; distinct from preparing a session, conducting a test or following an established protocol.

text.label: Medication labeling
aliases: Label pharmaceutical preparations for professional stock
text.description: Apply or prepare identification labels for drugs, chemicals or pharmaceutical preparations handled in professional stock; distinct from compounding a product, dispensing it to a recipient, recording a care event, and replenishing shelves.

text.label: Gathering intelligence
aliases: Gather law-enforcement intelligence for crime prevention/investigation
text.description: Research, verify and compile information about alleged offences or security concerns.

text.label: Veterinary records
aliases: Collect and maintain animal health/care records
text.description: Record animal weight, condition, treatments, medication and feeding information in animal-care work; distinct from human clinical documentation and an owner’s pet log.

text.label: Securities records
aliases: Maintain records of securities transactions for a client or employer
text.description: Maintain transaction/position records of bonds, shares or other securities bought or sold for a client/employer; distinct from executing trades, advising on investments, and generic accounting that does not expose this financial register subtype.

text.label: Refusing alcohol service
aliases: Persuade a customer to stop drinking, decline further service, and order transportation
text.description: As a service provider, intervene to limit a customer's alcohol consumption by asking them to stop drinking, declining further service and arranging transportation.

text.label: Modifying a device
aliases: Modify an existing technical device or system
text.description: Alter the configuration or construction of an existing technical device or system, including navigation equipment and prosthetic or supportive devices. Modification is distinct from routine adjustment, repair and assembling a new product.

text.label: Contract monitoring
aliases: Monitor contract performance and service fulfilment
text.description: Track whether a counterparty makes an agreed service available in the required format and time and escalate deviations; distinct from drafting/reviewing a contract, signing it, and providing the purchased service oneself.

text.label: Dish quality control
aliases: Monitor culinary quality of dishes throughout preparation/presentation
text.description: Check taste, appearance and preparation quality of dishes throughout kitchen production and presentation; distinct from food-safety compliance, routine cooking and a final point inspection.

text.label: Publication monitoring
aliases: Monitor publications and select/file articles relevant to clients or staff
text.description: Review current publications, identify articles of interest to a defined client/staff audience and save/clip them for use; distinct from casual reading or archiving a collection.

text.label: Street vending permit
aliases: Obtain authorization to sell at a market/street location
text.description: As a vendor, apply for/obtain required permission or license to establish a stall or sell food in a public place; distinct from the authority reviewing/granting an application.

text.label: Library AV and copy equipment
aliases: Operate library/gallery audiovisual and reprographic equipment
text.description: Operate AV presentation/projection and reproduction/copy equipment in a gallery, museum or library; distinct from installing equipment, creating media content and producing a print run.

text.label: Media interview
aliases: Participate in a media interview as an interviewee
text.description: Answer a journalist/media interviewer’s questions as an interviewee; distinct from conducting an interview, public speaking, writing promotional content and ordinary business communication.

text.label: Fitting a prosthesis or orthosis
aliases: Fit and adjust a prescribed assistive/prosthetic device for a patient
text.description: Fit a patient-specific assistive/prosthetic device and assess/adjust its fit, function and comfort for the patient, distinct from device manufacture, equipment installation, repair, calibration or the patient’s own use.

text.label: Arranging an insurance contract
aliases: Place or arrange an insurance/reinsurance contract
text.description: Arrange placement of an insurance or reinsurance contract with an insurer/underwriter or insurance market; distinct from advising customers, negotiating terms, reviewing contract language and administering a claim.

text.label: Preparing peripherals
aliases: Prepare a computer peripheral for a processing run
text.description: Read job setup instructions, select equipment/media/settings, load a computer peripheral and oversee run preparation; distinct from routine machine operation, software configuration and freight loading.

text.label: Classified ad orders
aliases: Receive and process orders for classified advertisements
text.description: Register a customer’s classified-ad order and apply applicable rate-card pricing before billing; distinct from writing/editing ad copy or preparing a customer invoice.

text.label: Personnel applications
aliases: Process personnel applications for employment or promotion
text.description: Receive, register, route and process job/promotion applications and communicate the result as personnel administration; distinct from the applicant writing their own application, candidate sourcing, and the manager deciding whom to hire/promote.

text.label: Policy servicing
text.description: Handle insurer-side processing across policy enrollment, cancellation, claims transactions, policy changes and associated payments. These are lifecycle transaction types under one selectable insurance-administration family; distinguish transaction type and role as facets. This does not imply underwriting, selling a policy, assessing claim merits, or a policyholder filing a claim.

text.label: Prosthetic impression
aliases: Make a patient-specific prosthetic fitting impression
text.description: Create a patient-specific cast/impression/pattern for fabricating an orthotic/prosthetic appliance, distinct from clinical diagnosis, device design or fabrication from an existing pattern.

text.label: Beauty services
aliases: Provide professional beauty, cosmetic and nail/foot-care services
text.description: Provide client-facing beauty and personal-care services: skin cleansing/cream or lotion application, facial/body massage, makeup, nail care, foot-ailment care, bath-client service, and waxing/sugaring/depilation. The exact service and provider/recipient context remain facets; this does not imply diagnosis or clinical treatment.

text.label: Hairdressing
aliases: Provide professional hairdressing and barbering services
text.description: Provide hairdressing and barbering services for clients, including cutting, washing, colouring, waving, styling, facial-hair grooming, scalp care and extensions.

text.label: Drug-free pain relief
aliases: Provide non-pharmacological pain relief within an established care plan
text.description: Provide provider-side massage or other non-pharmacological pain relief support (including pregnancy/labor contexts) under a plan; distinct from clinical pain diagnosis, pharmacological treatment and self-relief.

text.label: Real estate deal
aliases: Arrange real-estate contract closing and transfer of property rights
text.description: Coordinate the signing/closing of a property sale or lease and the associated conveyance or transfer of rights; distinct from negotiating/drafting terms or performing the registry/legal filing itself.

text.label: Releasing collateral
aliases: Release pledged collateral after loan repayment
text.description: Return an item held as loan security when the borrower repays the loan; distinct from commercial product returns, inventory receipt and sale of defaulted collateral.

text.label: Handling printouts and output
aliases: Retrieve, sort and route computer-processing output
text.description: Retrieve and sort output from computer programs and deliver the resulting data/files to the designated users; distinct from querying a dataset for analysis, transforming records, or sending an analytical report.

text.label: Survey sampling
aliases: Construct, maintain and use a survey sampling frame
text.description: Establish and maintain registers and sampling frames that operationally define a census or survey population and support sample selection; distinct from fielding the survey or maintaining a general administrative register.

text.label: Cashier work
aliases: Scan or weigh merchandise and record its checkout price
text.description: Identify/measure a product at point of sale and enter or retrieve the price for the cashier total; distinct from stocktaking, product display, lab measurement and seller payment receipt.

text.label: Triaging meeting requests
aliases: Screen or triage meeting and appointment requests
text.description: Review incoming requests for a meeting or appointment, decide whether/when they should proceed or be routed, and prioritize them before calendar scheduling. Distinct from reading/routing correspondence alone and from booking an already accepted meeting.

text.label: Betting odds
aliases: Assess wagering risk, set odds and manage bookmaker exposure
text.description: Estimate risk and set betting odds and decisions to hedge/decline exposure as a bookmaker; distinct from a customer placing a bet, financial reporting and croupier game facilitation.

text.label: Assortment and pricing
aliases: Set retail product assortment, stock levels and price levels
text.description: Decide what goods/variants to carry, in what quantities and at what price; distinct from counting existing stock, displaying a product and executing a sale.

text.label: Setting up draft lines
aliases: Set up kegs, taps and beverage supply lines
text.description: Connect beverage supply lines and tap kegs for bar dispensing; distinct from serving a drink, installing general appliances or maintaining non-beverage equipment.

text.label: Shelving books
aliases: Shelve and re-shelve library materials in the collection
text.description: Place books, periodicals and other library materials into assigned shelf locations for browsing/retrieval; distinct from warehouse stock replenishment and collection cataloging.

text.label: Interior materials and furniture
aliases: Select/specify materials, furniture and products for an interior
text.description: Select, specify and recommend furnishings/materials/products to meet functional and aesthetic criteria in an interior; distinct from purchasing them, creating a product, or designing the overall spatial concept.

text.label: Data transfer between systems
aliases: Import/export or transfer records between existing systems
text.description: Move existing data from one database/software system to another; distinct from cleaning/transformation for analysis, designing a repeatable ETL pipeline and administering databases.

text.label: Checking buyer age
aliases: Verify buyer age eligibility before a restricted sale
text.description: Check proof of age as a provider-side sale-compliance step; distinct from government identity verification or the buyer presenting ID as a personal action.

text.label: Guest payment authorization
aliases: Verify a hotel guest’s payment/credit authorization
text.description: Check a guest’s payment/credit authorization at room assignment/check-in, as a provider-side lodging control; distinct from processing the payment, underwriting a loan and the guest checking their own credit.

text.label: Title verification
aliases: Verify property title, legal description and ownership
text.description: Examine title, lien, judgment, easement, contract and map records to establish the legal description and ownership of property; distinct from market-value appraisal, contract drafting, conveyance and general document filing.

text.label: Animal artificial insemination
aliases: Assist with artificial insemination of animals
text.description: Assist with the technical tasks of artificial insemination in veterinary or animal-production work.

text.label: Weighing and logging cargo
aliases: Weigh goods within receipt, production, issue or dispatch and keep records
text.description: Measure the weight of goods as an inventory/transport control at receipt, production, issue or dispatch, recording the weight; distinct from scientific measurement, measuring/marking trade materials, and merely receiving/storing/shipping a shipment.

text.label: Boiler room
aliases: Operate a boiler or steam utility system
text.description: Operate a boiler, steam plant, and related auxiliary equipment to provide energy and utility services.

text.label: Rock extraction
text.description: Extract rock, ore, coal, and other mineral materials.

text.label: Blasting
text.description: Carry out blasting or material-fragmentation work at a mining, construction, or demolition site.

text.label: Ore processing
aliases: Process ore and extract mineral products
text.description: Process mineral raw material, separating and preparing useful products or concentrates.

text.label: Clearing drainage ditches
text.description: Clear agricultural drainage ditches to maintain the land.

text.label: Tree felling
text.description: Harvest timber in a forest by felling trees, removing branches, and preparing trunks for further processing.

text.label: Forest fire watch
aliases: Watch for fires in a forest area
text.description: Monitor a forest area to detect and report signs of fire.

text.label: Reforestation
aliases: Prepare a forest site and regenerate woodland
text.description: Assess and prepare a forest site for regeneration, establish new stands, and tend young growth. Species, site, and stage of work can be specified separately.

text.label: Hay and straw
aliases: Gather, stack, or move hay and straw
text.description: Gather, stack, and move hay and straw for storage, animal feed, or bedding.

text.label: Livestock health
text.description: Assess farm animals’ condition and maintain their health through care, prevention, and appropriate veterinary support.

text.label: Fishing gear
aliases: Prepare and maintain commercial fishing gear
text.description: Prepare, repair, and maintain commercial fishing gear.

text.label: Wild animal breeding
text.description: Breed, raise, and keep non-domesticated animals in a managed operation to produce goods or replenish populations. Distinguish this from hunting and keeping animals for leisure.

text.label: Operating a lift or crane
aliases: Lift and position loads with hoisting equipment
text.description: Raise, lower, move, and position materials or equipment using hoisting machinery.

text.label: Securing cargo
aliases: Secure and distribute a load in a vehicle
text.description: Place and secure cargo in a vehicle and distribute it for transport.

text.label: Paper and cardboard products
aliases: Convert paper and cardboard into finished products
text.description: Convert sheet or roll paper and cardboard into containers, bags, envelopes, and other finished products; distinguish this from packaging finished goods.

text.label: Forging and stamping
text.description: Forge and shape metal blanks and products.

text.label: Concrete and stone
aliases: Make concrete, stone, or mineral construction products
text.description: Make and finish precast concrete, artificial-stone, and other mineral construction products.

text.label: Casting molds
aliases: Make a foundry mold or core
text.description: Make, prepare, and repair foundry molds and cores used to produce metal goods.

text.label: Papermaking
text.description: Produce pulp and paper sheets from cellulosic raw materials.

text.label: Plastic products
text.description: Mold and manufacture parts and products from plastic.

text.label: Rubber products
text.description: Manufacture parts and products from rubber.

text.label: Chip manufacturing
text.description: Manufacture semiconductor chips and components.

text.label: Coatings and plating
aliases: Plate or coat a product surface
text.description: Apply a protective or decorative coating to a product, including electroplating and metallized coatings.

text.label: Tobacco processing
aliases: Process tobacco: prepare raw tobacco or manufacture tobacco products
text.description: Prepare raw tobacco or manufacture tobacco products. The recorded activity can be further identified by its processing stage.

text.label: Chemical production
aliases: Manufacture or process formulated chemical products
text.description: Manufacture or process chemical and other formulated products in an industrial plant. The product category, process and equipment can be specified separately.

text.label: Metallurgy
aliases: Process primary metal by refining, casting, or forming
text.description: Operate or monitor primary-metal processing, including refining, purifying, casting, rolling, heat treatment and extrusion. The processing stage, material and equipment can be specified separately.

text.label: Sawmilling
aliases: Process logs into lumber or wood panels
text.description: Saw logs into lumber and produce veneer, plywood, and wood panels.

text.label: Product tasting
aliases: Evaluate the taste, aroma, or sensory qualities of food or drink
text.description: Evaluate the taste, aroma, and other sensory properties of foods and beverages, and record tasting results.

text.label: Glassworking
text.description: Shape and process glass to make a product or component.

text.label: Leather and fur dressing
aliases: Tan and finish hides or fur
text.description: Process hides and fur into leather or fur material, and sort, finish, and dye the material.

text.label: Wood treatment
aliases: Treat and preserve wood or lumber
text.description: Dry, impregnate, protect, and otherwise treat wood or finished wooden products.

text.label: Basket weaving
aliases: Weave baskets and products from rattan, willow, or reed
text.description: Weave baskets, furniture, and other products from willow, rattan, reed, and similar flexible materials.

text.label: Coil winding
text.description: Wind wire coils for electrical and electronic components.

text.label: Window cleaning
aliases: Wash and polish windows and glass surfaces
text.description: Wash and polish windows, shop windows, and other glass surfaces.

text.label: Dry cleaning
aliases: Professionally dry-clean textiles and leather goods
text.description: Clean clothing, textiles, and leather goods as a professional dry-cleaning service.

text.label: Plastering
text.description: Apply plaster or similar compounds to walls, ceilings, and other surfaces, then finish them.

text.label: Scaffolding
aliases: Assemble and erect temporary construction scaffolding
text.description: Assemble, erect, and dismantle temporary construction scaffolding.

text.label: Earthworks
text.description: Excavate, move, grade, level, and compact soil and similar materials at a construction site.

text.label: Wallpapering
text.description: Prepare surfaces and hang wallpaper or other flexible wall coverings.

text.label: Rigging
aliases: Rig and position suspended equipment or structures
text.description: Prepare lifting rigging and position suspended equipment, materials, or structures.

text.label: Cable splicing
aliases: Join or splice cable, rope, or wire
text.description: Join and splice cables, ropes, or wires during installation and repair.

text.label: Facade cleaning
aliases: Clean and restore contaminated or damaged building surfaces
text.description: Clean and restore contaminated or damaged building surfaces by removing contaminants, mold, soot, or damaged layers.

text.label: Upholstery
aliases: Upholster or reupholster furniture and seats
text.description: Make, install, repair, or replace padded upholstery on furniture, seats, and other objects.

text.label: Train assembly
aliases: Couple rail vehicles and assemble a train
text.description: Couple and uncouple rail vehicles and assemble a train from rolling stock.

text.label: Mooring
aliases: Moor a vessel and handle its lines
text.description: Moor a vessel and handle its mooring lines, ropes, and equipment.

text.label: Preparing a working animal
aliases: Prepare a working animal for transport or farm work
text.description: Prepare a working animal to perform a transport or agricultural task.

text.label: Power lines
text.description: Install, maintain, and repair overhead or underground power lines and electric traction lines.

text.label: Quilt
text.description: A project or session umbrella chosen by the user for design, piecing, basting, quilting, binding, and finishing. Component actions may be tracked separately and concurrently as overlapping, non-additive views.

text.label: Quilt stitching
text.description: Stitch through layers of textile to join them and/or decorate them. The top may be wholecloth, pieced, or appliquéd; hand and machine quilting differ by method. Piecing a quilt top is a separate operation.

text.label: Home carpentry
text.description: Measure, fit, join, or install wooden elements, doors, shelves, furniture, or trim when building, repairing, or improving a home. Payment and professional status are not inferred from the activity.

text.label: Wood carving
text.description: Carve a shape, image, ornament, or other feature from wood by removing material with suitable carving tools. Making an object, creating artwork, and restoring a wooden part can be different contexts for this activity.

text.label: Canoe slalom
text.description: Practice navigating slalom gates in a canoe on a water course, or take part in a corresponding competition. Recreational paddling and sprint racing are not automatically slalom.

text.label: Canoe sprint
text.description: Practice canoe sprint paddling or take part in a corresponding race. Distance, boat class, and event format are specified separately; gate slalom is a different discipline.

text.label: Downhill MTB
text.description: Practice descending a mountain-bike course, whether prepared or natural, in training or competition. Simply riding downhill during any bike outing does not necessarily mean this discipline was chosen.

text.label: Enduro MTB
text.description: Practice enduro mountain biking or take part in an enduro competition. A competition session typically combines timed downhill stages and transfers; the event, not this activity card, defines its specific rules.

text.label: Trail MTB
text.description: Ride a mountain bike on trails and off-road routes in a trail-riding style. This may be independent recreational riding without a race; location, surface, and intensity are optional details.

text.label: Cross-country MTB
text.description: Ride a mountain bike in a cross-country format on varied terrain with climbs and descents. Training, recreational riding, and a particular competition format are specified separately.

text.label: Nordic walking
text.description: Practice Nordic walking by walking while actively using specialized poles to propel and engage the body. It is a distinct walking technique; ordinary support with trekking poles does not automatically count as Nordic walking.

text.label: Handcycle racing
aliases: Compete in a handcycling para-cycling event
text.description: Take part in a para-cycling competition on a handcycle, such as a road race, individual time trial, or relay. Class and format are specified for the particular event, not inferred from the device alone.

text.label: POP tennis
text.description: Play POP Tennis according to the selected format of this racquet sport. POP Tennis, APTA platform tennis, and padel are distinct sports; the ambiguous word “paddle” alone does not establish which one was chosen.

text.label: Qigong
text.description: Perform a chosen qigong practice involving movement and/or held postures, breath work, and attention. Forms may be more active or more still; purpose and tradition are not inferred automatically, and no therapeutic effect is promised.

text.label: Race walking
text.description: Practice race walking as an athletics discipline with defined requirements for ground contact and a straightened leg. Training and competition differ by context; Nordic walking with poles is a different activity.

text.label: Relay
aliases: Take part in an athletics relay
text.description: Compete in a team relay race; distance and mode of movement are subordinate discipline and format facets.

text.label: Spearfishing
text.description: Hunt fish underwater. The diving method is specified separately; breath-holding without hunting and observing the underwater environment are different activities.

text.label: Fast wheelchair sprint
aliases: Do fast or interval wheelchair propulsion for fitness
text.description: Propel a manual wheelchair for exercise in a chosen fast or interval-based training mode. “Run” does not mean running on foot, imply a universal speed, or establish medical status.

text.label: Wheelchair stroll
aliases: Do leisure-pace wheelchair propulsion for fitness
text.description: Propel a manual wheelchair for exercise at a chosen walking pace. This is the person’s own physical practice; everyday mobility, accompanying another person, and racing are distinct contexts.

text.label: Auto slalom
aliases: Practice or compete in automotive slalom
text.description: Drive a car around a closed course through a marked sequence of cones or other control markers, negotiating them in order with accuracy and control; the run may be timed and include penalties. Practice and competition belong to the same base activity; rules for a specific event are specified separately.

text.label: Motorboat navigation
aliases: Navigate a powered recreational boat on a route (UIM Pleasure Navigation)
text.description: As the operator or pilot of a powered recreational boat, actively plan and steer it along a route or course when route handling or navigation practice is itself the activity. This includes UIM regularity or course competitions, social rallies, training, demonstrations, skill checks, and intentional non-competitive navigation practice. A chosen destination alone, a trip made to get somewhere, or a passenger cruise does not constitute this separate activity; rowing, sailing, and closed-course motorboat racing are also excluded.

text.label: Quick warm-up
text.description: A few minutes of movement in the middle of the day: squats, stairs or a couple of exercises to break up long sitting.
